title: Inference Trace Row
description: Per-call log emitted by the GAD inference gateway. One row per LLM/SLM call regardless of tier (Tier 0 local, Tier 1 cheap remote, Tier 2 high-end open, Tier 3 frontier enrichment). Drives routing decisions, replacement metrics, and training-candidate harvesting. Decisions: slm-learning-214 (GAD-owned inference is default), slm-learning-217 (day-to-day replacement matrix determines training priorities), slm-learning-103 (compare-and-compete discipline), slm-learning-100 (delta graph provenance).

agent.description: Agent identity (claude-code, codex-cli, kael-tooluse-v1, dr-stein-orchestrator, etc.).

runtime.description: Runtime that issued the call (claude-cli, vllm, sglang, modal-fn, openai-sdk, openrouter, etc.).

task_shape.description: Maps to teachers.json task_shape vocabulary (code_function_completion, code_repair, tool_action_json, math_reasoning, trajectory_completion, bulk_paraphrase, chain_of_thought_synth, frontier_judge_panel, logit_inspection) plus replacement-plan additions (gad_note, gad_decision, gad_handoff, eval_summary, tech_stack_inference, dataset_cleanup, delta_packet_creation, context_compression, classification, repo_repair, architecture_review, artifact_generation).

task_shape_confidence.description: Router's confidence the task_shape label is correct.

tier.description: Which replacement tier handled the call.

used_model.description: Model registry id actually used (matches data/registry/model_families.json or a Kael adapter id).

candidate_models.description: Other registry ids the router considered before selecting used_model.

could_local_handle.description: Router's pre-call estimate that a Tier 0/1 model could complete the task. Compared to outcome to score router calibration.

fallback_reason.description: Why the call escalated past Tier 0/1 (or 'none' if it didn't).

fallback_chain.description: Ordered list of model ids tried in this call (router cascade).

cost_usd.description: Resolved USD cost (API price * tokens, or compute_seconds * rate for self-hosted).

outcome.description: Final disposition of this call's output.

human_edit_distance.description: Levenshtein or token edit distance between model output and final accepted text. 0 = used as-is.

verifier_result.description: Optional verifier signal (test_suite_diff_runner, json_schema_validator, contract_runner, etc.).

value.description: Operator/agent annotation of how valuable this output was. Drives training-candidate selection.

training_candidate.description: Whether this trace should be promoted to the delta packet pipeline (per slm-learning-100/192).

delta_packet_ref.description: If promoted, the packet_id created from this trace.
